title: The Cloud That Came Down
intro: This quiz follows Maya and Leo as they learn how fog and mist form and why fog can make travel more difficult.

questions.prompt: What did Maya and Leo think had happened outside?
choices: Snow had covered the town
A cloud had fallen near the ground
Smoke had filled the street
The houses had disappeared
questions.explanation: Maya and Leo thought a cloud had fallen near the ground.

choices: Tiny water droplets floating in the air
Dust and sand from the ground
Frozen pieces of snow
Smoke from clouds
questions.explanation: Fog is made of tiny water droplets floating in the air.

choices: Warm air rises and becomes fire
Moist air cools, and water vapor condenses into tiny droplets
Rainwater freezes on the ground
Wind pushes clouds into buildings
questions.explanation: Fog forms when moist air cools and water vapor condenses into tiny droplets.

questions.prompt: What is one difference between fog and mist?
choices: Fog is warmer than mist
Mist contains no water
Fog is thicker, while mist is thinner
Mist forms only at night
questions.explanation: Fog is thicker, while mist is thinner.

questions.prompt: Why did the school bus move slowly in the fog?
choices: The road was covered with snow
The driver could not see very far ahead
The bus had run out of fuel
The children asked the driver to stop
questions.explanation: The bus moved slowly because the driver could not see very far ahead.
